notes.title: The First Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, hope you’ve been enjoying Wulverblade! It’s been a while since we posted something, so we thought it was time to let everyone know what we’ve been up to as we release some of the bugfixes we’ve been working on. Most of what our patch today addresses are issues brought to our attention by the community in either [url=steamcommunity.com/app/587180/discussions/] the steam forums[/url] or [url=discord.gg/wulverblade] our official discord server[/url]. We’re always interested in reading what you have to say, so please stop by.

[h1]Today’s patch includes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fix to end-level leaderboards invisible text
[*]Change “Call me Vlad” target from 1000 impalements to 250
[*]Fix to “Primus Cades” achievement failing to award if you skip the cutscene
[*]Fix to being unable to rebind “B” button on controller
[*]Fix to player 2 being unable to use keyboard/mouse bindings [i](Any saved keyboard/mouse bindings may be reset as a result)[/i]
[*]Fix to “White squares” bug by adding new image prompts for controllers, keyboard, and mouse
[*]Minor UI fixes
[*]Tons more minor bugfixes and improvements!
[/list]

Earlier this month we were able to attend PAX East and represent Wulverbade at the Indie Megabooth. It was a blast being able to connect with a few of you and to show off the game to lots of new people, including this awesome cosplayer who stopped by our booth who we swore must have been none other than our brave hero Caradoc.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154307/7c04c5cd8efd526d8110a7eeb8425d8a9c81cf9b.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28154307/aa6684c3718ba4198a6d1609a17006b523642d06.jpg[/img]
The centerpiece of our booth was a one-of-a-kind arcade cabinet, built to showcase Wulverblade the way the games that inspired it existed. The cab’s back at the office now; and we’ve all been busy trying to catch up with all the huge scores from PAX (after work hours, of course :B1:).

We’ve had a productive and busy few months after launch and just wanted to thank you all for your support, reviews, and for just playing the game we’ve been working so hard on for the past few years. We’re excited for the future of Wulverblade and want express our gratitude to you all for making it possible with us.

Best,

Darkwind Media and Fully Illustrated
:WulverSigil:

notes.title: The imminent release date is being announced next Monday (22nd)!!
notes.notes:
https://youtu.be/Jl_Wy-56jkQ
Hey Everyone,

The imminent release date of Wulverblade for Steam, PS4 and Xbox is being announced next Monday (22nd Jan). We are SO excited to be at this point and can't wait for you all to see what we've been making for this past 6 years!

The Steam version is kicking ass with an uncapped frame rate (my GTX 760 pulls 100fps!), lightning quick loading times, achievements and full trading card support.

Prepare to experience brutal Britannia!
